layers.name: Core Kernel
layers.responsibility: Foundational domain model, contracts, governance, state, and extension infrastructure

layers.name: Intent & Modeling Layer

layers.name: Synthesis & Specification Layer
layers.responsibility: Compile canonical model into deliverable specifications
components: Specification Compiler (API, Data Model, Workflows, Contracts)

layers.name: Verification & Governance
layers.responsibility: Validate, simulate, assess risk, and authorize progression through gates

layers.name: Memory & Knowledge
layers.responsibility: Track decisions, evidence, outcomes, and enable retrieval

layers.name: Planning Layer
layers.responsibility: Transform validated specifications into executable plans with dynamic replanning

layers.name: Runtime Layer
layers.responsibility: Execute plans with durable state machines and external integrations

layers.name: Integration & Adapters
components: LLM Adapter (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.)

layers.name: Observability & Audit
layers.responsibility: Trace, audit, measure, and analyze system behavior

core_capabilities.name: Intent Engine
core_capabilities.responsibility: Transform raw ideas into structured Intent models
invariants: Output must conform to Intent.v1 schema
All goals must be measurable
Constraints must be typed and severity-tagged

core_capabilities.name: Domain Engine
core_capabilities.responsibility: Decompose intent into domain models with bounded contexts
invariants: Every entity must belong to exactly one bounded context
No cyclic dependencies between bounded contexts
All capabilities must be associated with at least one entity

core_capabilities.name: Requirements Engine
core_capabilities.responsibility: Derive structured requirements from domain models
invariants: Every requirement must trace to at least one intent goal
Every requirement must have at least one acceptance criterion
Non-functional requirements must include measurable thresholds

core_capabilities.name: Context & Environment Engine
invariants: All external signals must have source attribution
Regulatory constraints must be flagged as Critical severity
Market data must include confidence scores

core_capabilities.name: Product Compiler (PRD)
core_capabilities.responsibility: Compile canonical model into Product Requirements Document
invariants: PRD must reference source requirements by ID
All prioritized features must trace to validated requirements
PRD version must match canonical model version

core_capabilities.name: Architecture Compiler (ARD)
core_capabilities.responsibility: Compile canonical model into Architecture Requirements Document
invariants: Every capability must map to at least one component
All non-functional requirements must have corresponding architectural mechanisms
Architecture decisions must be recorded as ArchitectureDecision.v1

core_capabilities.name: Validation Engine
core_capabilities.responsibility: Verify specifications against contracts, schemas, and invariants
invariants: Invalid contracts must be rejected with specific violation details
Validation must be idempotent
All violations must be traceable to specific rules

core_capabilities.name: Simulation & Verification Engine
core_capabilities.responsibility: Simulate and verify system behavior before execution
invariants: Simulations must be reproducible with same inputs
All simulation assumptions must be recorded
High-risk simulations must trigger additional verification
core_capabilities.activation_policy: Activated based on risk level, not before every gate

core_capabilities.name: Risk Engine
core_capabilities.responsibility: Identify, score, and track risks throughout the lifecycle
invariants: Risk score = probability × impact
Critical risks must always have mitigation plans
All risks must have assigned owners

core_capabilities.name: Decision Gateway
core_capabilities.responsibility: Authorize progression through gates based on evidence and policies
invariants: Every gate decision must produce a DecisionRecord.v1
Bypassed gates must have documented justification
Critical-risk decisions must require human approval

core_capabilities.name: Decision Memory
core_capabilities.responsibility: Persist decisions, rationale, and outcomes for future reference
invariants: All decisions must be immutable once recorded
Outcomes must be linked to original predictions
Feedback loop must be event-driven, not autonomous

core_capabilities.name: Execution Planning Engine
core_capabilities.responsibility: Transform validated specifications into executable plans
invariants: All dependencies must be acyclic
Every task must have an assigned capability
All required capabilities must be in Capability Registry
Plan must include all required gates

core_capabilities.name: Dynamic Planner
core_capabilities.responsibility: Replan in response to events, failures, and new evidence
invariants: Every replan must create a new plan version
Replan reason must be recorded in provenance
Replanning must respect original intent and critical constraints
Replanning cannot bypass required gates

capability_registry.purpose: Runtime-discoverable registry of all capabilities available to the Kernel
invariants: No duplicate capability names
All registered capabilities must have valid schemas
Capability removal requires deprecation period

extension_api.purpose: Allow new capabilities to be added without Core Kernel modification
invariants: Extensions cannot directly mutate canonical state
All extension calls must be recorded in provenance
Extensions must respect governance policies

governance_kernel.purpose: Centralized enforcement of constraints, policies, rules, and invariants

components.description: Hard limitations that must never be violated
Decision rules that guide system behavior
components.enforcement: Policy engine evaluation at decision points
examples: IF confidence < 0.7 THEN use strong reasoning model
IF production deployment THEN require human gate

components.description: Properties that must always hold true
examples: No cyclic dependencies in task graphs
Canonical state cannot be corrupted by extensions

critical_invariants.statement: Engine cannot mutate canonical state directly
Every state transition has an event
Every replan creates a new plan version
Kernel failure cannot corrupt execution state
Kernel does not require Restate internals

standard_gates.name: Simulation Gate
standard_gates.decision_authority: Automated for Low Risk, Human for High Risk

xstate_boundary.purpose: State machine semantics for task and plan lifecycles
xstate_boundary.integration: Kernel emits state machine contracts; XState runtime executes them
invariants: Kernel does not import XState library directly
State transitions are validated by Kernel before emission
XState events are recorded in provenance

restate_boundary.purpose: Durable execution of workflows and tasks
restate_boundary.integration: Kernel emits ExecutionPlan.v1; Restate executes it durably
restate_boundary.restate_responsibility: Execute plan with retry, timeout, recovery, persistence
invariants: Kernel does not import Restate SDK directly
Restate is responsible for workflow state, not domain state
Restate execution failures are reported back as events
Restate cannot modify canonical Kernel state

llm_boundary.integration: Kernel calls LLM adapter; adapter routes to providers
llm_boundary.adapter_responsibility: Route to providers, handle failures, aggregate responses
invariants: Kernel never references specific LLM provider APIs
All LLM calls are recorded in provenance
LLM outputs are validated before acceptance
LLM is never the source of system truth

mcp_boundary.purpose: Tool and agent integration via Model Context Protocol
mcp_boundary.integration: Kernel defines tool contracts; MCP adapter executes them
mcp_boundary.kernel_responsibility: Define tool schemas and invocation contracts
mcp_boundary.mcp_responsibility: Execute tools, manage sessions, handle errors
invariants: All tool calls are idempotent where possible
Tool failures are recorded and trigger replanning
Tool outputs are validated against schemas

test_quality: Contract tests for every versioned contract

testing_strategy.critical_invariant_tests: All 15 critical invariants must have dedicated tests

deployment.local_workspace: Disposable, used only for Git operations and build

ci_cd.branch_protection: All checks must pass before merge to main

extension_points.method: Implement Capability trait and register in Capability Registry
Implement LLM adapter trait and register
Define policy and register in Governance Kernel

anti_patterns: Modifying Core Kernel to add capability
Direct coupling to specific LLM providers

messaging: Event bus (optional, not required for v1)
